name: 221030_2228_FR_SurfingWaves.wav
description:
Wind and surfing waves on the beach (binaural, please use headset for 3D effects). 
I made this recording on the sand beach of Saint Gildas de Rhuys (Brittany, France), during a quite windy afternoon. Waves sounded particularly impressive, and I thought it would be interesting to share ! 
Recorded in October 2022 with an Olympus LS-P4 and Ohrwurm 3D binaural microphones. 
Fade in/out and high pass filter at 60Hz -6dB/oct applied in Audacity. 
(If you want to use this sound as a mono audio file, you may have to delete one channel to avoid phase issues).
